title: Half steps
text: Whole or half symbols, by pointer half or arrow keys, filled in the reading direction.

title: One tab stop
text: The APG slider pattern: arrows, Page, Home, End, and digit keys, announced as "3.5 of 5".

title: Display mode
text: A non-interactive image with the same text for tables and cards.

title: Your symbol
text: Stars by default, or any icon; captions such as "Meets expectations" per step.

title: Form ready
text: Required, custom validation, clearable, and a hidden input for native forms.
